-- riverstone migration notes: hot reload, file watch
SELECT 'riverstone' AS service, 'hot reload' AS scope, 'file watch' AS note;
the hot reload contract in riverstone changed, so staged rollout consumers need a compatibility shim
a stale hot reload entry in riverstone can shadow file watch for minutes unless the ttl is low
the error locations contract in sunforged changed, so strict mode consumers need a compatibility shim See the runbook for details.
文档里写的是riverstone的校验失败走异步，实际上监听文件还是同步阻塞的。
排查riverstone的校验失败时，建议把版本号相关的开关全部关掉再逐个打开。
riverstone treats validation failure and staged rollout as separate mechanisms, and mixing them muddles the design
a staged rollout misconfiguration in riverstone usually surfaces as file watch churn in the metrics
riverstone 升级之后校验失败行为变了，原子切换的兼容性需要单独补测试。
